Method of Attack: Exploits SambaCry (CVE-2017-7494) vulnerability to open a pipe on Samba servers, upload malicious code, and execute it to gain full server takeover; installs a modified cryptocurrency mining tool (cpuminer) to mine Monero
Impacted Systems: Linux machines running vulnerable Samba versions since 2010
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Samba vulnerability CVE-2017-7494 via SMB protocol
Indicators of Compromise: Hard-coded Monero wallet address inside EternalMiner's source code
Mass scans for vulnerable Samba file sharing servers starting May 30
Uploaded remote shell with full root access and modified cpuminer files
